item.title: Federating Enterprise Identity: Deploying a Sovereign SSO Architecture with FreeIPA and Keycloak
item.description: Faced with the risks of scattered identities and dormant accounts, this technical guide walks through building a robust IAM infrastructure. Through a hands-on lab interconnecting FreeIPA (LDAP/Kerberos) and Keycloak, discover how to centralize authentication and implement an SSO mechanism via OpenID Connect (OIDC) to secure critical applications like Gitea and Grafana.
